subject: Public track: your four changes are being applied
body: Applying all four before the distract stage, so nothing needs regenerating: (1) own_future_work dropped, order is named -> contemporaneous -> generated; (2) blind Option 1/2 rewrite, fixed one-sentence imperative template, check_pair rules (one sentence, digits both-or-neither, no first person), style-leak probe in the gate report (order-averaged score, chance 0.5, flagged when the clustered CI's low end is above 0.5); (3) prose renamed to 'public track' in my files and the PLAN 6.3/12.2 distractor passages; (4) researcher identity moves to data/researchers/<slug>/identity.json (banned names, exclude_text, exclude_domains), so Owain Evans needs only that file plus consent. Status: Marius corpus 127 docs; Exa extraction done; Claude check running now. I won't harvest Owain until CONSENT.md records consent.
